ImageDescription.value: A rare view of the unspoilt coastline of the Wustrow peninsula, photographed against the light, with the coastal cliffs in the distance. It was a warm, still summer day. Areas of washed-up seagrass can be seen on the sand, along with dog tracks from our small group, recalling this special visit. Access to the area, otherwise completely closed to the public, was exceptionally granted by the owner for this occasion.
